verdictProse:
Hostile validation verdict, admin PWA source candidate 1c2272714fb02091e390f751510341e6824e3d22, gate admin-pwa-source-round3 retry (staging readiness only). Timestamp 2026-10-29T00:00:40 local. Reviewer claude-opus-5-5 (runtime receipt); effort high is launch-only.

OverallVerdict DISAGREE. Accuracy 95. Completeness 93. Both are below 98, and the workspace-rules and requirements surfaces have FAILs. PASS 31, FAIL 4, UNKNOWN 3 of 38.

What holds: HEAD is clean; all five TRX and JUnit hashes match the index; unit 587, PostgreSQL 68, browser 77 and planner 6/6 pass with 0 failed and 0 skipped, 1:1 by name, all executed after the 22:43:11 commit with a fresh build. The source manifest equals the HEAD tree over its scope (278 paths, 0 byte drift). Round2 G1 to G4 are substantively fixed: the Node planner is a throwing stub, the PowerShell planner was mock-gated with five rejected controls before its final edit and passes the same six cases for real, and the adapter analyzer receipt precedes the fixture rerun. The 7b20e44 change keeps the retry test sensitive: it can only observe the retry POST and still fails on 503. The invitation code copies inside the click gesture, falls back to writeText, keeps a selectable link with a manual-copy message on denial or unavailability, and never claims success when creation fails. Seven browser cases, including a real Chromium clipboard read, pass. The security core, admin worker and manifest, guest-only public routes and navigation guards verify. INVITE-COPY-01/02 are recorded and unsatisfied on the FR and TEST. Nothing is claimed done or deployed.

Why DISAGREE:
F-R3-1 (medium, BDPv4): the invitation mock gate covers only the copy and fallback observation oracle. Four product cases that existed at gate time never ran against mocks, two cases were added after the 22:34:27 implementation edit, and no receipt shows room-screen.tsx was unmodified at the 22:29:35 gate. Operator decision needed: exception or remediation.
F-R3-2 (low): the planner's empty-history case has no rejecting negative control, and the gate accepts any three failures.
F-R3-3 (low): the planner, CLI, manifest generator and gate scripts have no analyzer receipts. They are clean on the reviewer's static check.
F-R3-4 (low): no structured criterion covers the planner contract, and TR-SCHEMA-PROVISIONING-023 notes still name the retired .mjs.
UNKNOWN: runtime effort; the prior failsafe's fate (absent, with no visible group); whether the invitation requirement change had a plan and approval.
I-R3-1 to I-R3-11 are informational and include my own partial echo of the API key prefix in a search pattern.

Not claimed and still pending: migration 012 on staging then production, live GitHub consent, standalone phone OAuth continuity, physical installation, hosted invitation behavior, hosted rollout and power-loss durability.
